title: autoSynth
summary: An agentic tool for generating synthetic tabular data from arbitrary dataframes. Its Jupyter notebook workflow fits and samples SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer against user data, using SingleTableMetadata for schema detection, to produce synthetic datasets on demand.
